::: {#sol-implied-for-all}

1. The sentence is about every string, so it is
   $\forall s, L(s) \Rightarrow N(s)$.
2. True: a string with more than 3 characters has at least 1.
3. The converse is $\forall s, N(s) \Rightarrow L(s)$:
   "if a string is not empty, then it has more than 3 characters".
   It is false.
   The string `"ab"` is a counterexample:
   it is not empty, but it has only 2 characters.

:::
